test_title: PYST 164: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: K, L, M, N, O and P are six friends sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of K. K is sitting to the immediate right of N. L is sitting to the immediate left of N. P is sitting between L and O. Who is sitting to the immediate right of P?
solution:
Given: K, L, M, N, O and P are six friends sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of K.

2) K is sitting to the immediate right of N.

3) L is sitting to the immediate left of N.

4) P is sitting between L and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71e541dbe0f65bbc0b3bff3f113f9f4433f22a70e25eb191e391c811eba11be3.png] 

Here, 'L' is sitting to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
